theorems.name: Submission.c1_injective_fderiv_local_lower_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn p) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G U → ∀ x ∈ U, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G x) → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ Metric.closedBall x r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ (∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, ∀ z' ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, c * ‖z - z'‖ ≤ ‖G z - G z'‖) ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall x r, ∀ v : Rn n, c * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ G z v‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
